mentions.name: PostSam
mentions.description: An AI-powered social media management tool that creates, schedules, and publishes content automatically across Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and Threads. It generates content tailored to your brand voice from initial brand info, builds full content campaigns with posting schedules, offers a calendar interface to review, edit, or reschedule posts before they go live, auto-publishes to all connected accounts, and learns from your edits to improve future content. Live and working, with users reportedly seeing good engagement after setting it up once.
mentions.problem: Solo founders spend hours each week on social media — writing posts, scheduling them, and managing multiple accounts — and the author wanted something that could handle the entire workflow automatically while still letting them stay in control.
mentions.audience: Solo founders and business owners who need to maintain a presence across multiple social media accounts without spending hours each week managing posts.
